title: Sweep-close pre-migration backlog findings
action: Via bee CLI only: for each actionable row (friction/finding/review-finding) in .bee/backlog.jsonl dated before 2026-07-12, check whether its target still exists in the Rust tree; append a backlog-closed/outcome row naming the original title and reason (target deleted in Rust migration, or still-valid-kept). Never hand-edit the jsonl. Report counts closed vs kept.
goal: Entropy backlog-without-outcome term collapses; future triage stops wading through dead rows.
verify: bee backlog counts reflects the closes; each close row carries a reason.

trace.outcome: Swept 68 actionable pre-2026-07-12 backlog rows (friction/finding/review-finding): closed 40 whose target was Node-era .mjs code deleted in the Rust migration (or demonstrably superseded/fixed in packages/bee-rs), kept 28 still-valid rows describing process/design concerns not tied to a dead file
trace.commit_pending: store rows appended on main; orchestrator lands the store commit at wave close
